# Elevation candidate source

Repository: https://github.com/drbo6/chiriboga
Commit: c863f5af74ceb4fa821a4c84d3f643efffacb7ba
File: sets/elevation.js (copied without edits)
License: GPL-3.0, retained here.

This file defines 76 of the 82 Elevation card IDs. It is a candidate implementation, not a claim of complete tested expansion support. Only the cards required by the explicitly enabled Core Sets decks are intended for the initial rollout. Local compatibility/correction code belongs in engine/elevation-compat.js, not this vendor file. The original Gateway vendor remains unchanged.
